class.name: Impostor
class.brief_description: A node baked from many directions, drawn far away as a single quad.

method.name: bake
method.description: Bakes [param node] and everything visible under it, as it looks unlit, from [param grid] by [param grid] directions, each [param tile_size] pixels square. It renders, a view a frame or two, so it takes a moment and doesn't work headless. Await the signal for a [Dictionary]: [code]ok[/code], or [code]error[/code] ([code]"not_in_tree"[/code], [code]"no_renderer"[/code], [code]"nothing_to_bake"[/code] or [code]"not_drawn"[/code]) and [code]message[/code].

method.name: get_mesh
method.description: The quad to draw the impostor with, with its [ImpostorMaterial] set up.

members.member: The middle of what was baked, in the node's own space.
How many directions across and down the texture holds.
How far what was baked reaches from [member center].
